default_namespace.description: Name of default namespace for entities (`default`, if not set). May also be provided via `BACKSTAGE_DEFAULT_NAMESPACE` environment variable.

headers.description: Headers to be sent with each request to the Backstage API. Useful for authentication. May also be provided via `BACKSTAGE_HEADERS` environment variable.

retries.description: Number of retries to attempt on recoverable API errors (default: 0). May also be provided via `BACKSTAGE_RETRIES` environment variable.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for requests to the Backstage API in seconds (default: 15). May also be provided via `BACKSTAGE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` environment variable.
